ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\&\\&set.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{0\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{1\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{2\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{3\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{4\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\{5\\}.*")))
